description: Update an existing mutable scheduled post by id. Supply changed content, scheduled_at, timezone, or metadata in body. Overwrites those fields and re-enqueues publication unless approval is required; completed posts cannot be edited. Returns the updated post. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_update_post
title: Update Post
